name: Speak with Gramma
summary: Tommy Joe Stonefield asks Gramma Stonefield for a way to reach Maybell Maclure. Their families keep them apart, and he hopes to meet her without drawing their kin into conflict.

sections.title: A Feud and Forbidden Love
sections.body: Tommy Joe and Maybell hide their love from their families. He turns to Gramma Stonefield, hoping she can find them a chance to meet in secret. Their kin must not discover the romance and turn old hostility into violence.

sections.title: Gramma's Cunning
sections.body: Gramma Stonefield knows the families cannot truly unite while their bad blood remains. Still, she will not let that end the young couple's hopes. She begins seeking small chances to bring Tommy Joe and Maybell together.

faq.q: Why does Tommy Joe want me to speak with his Gramma?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe loves Maybell Maclure, but their families' feud keeps them apart. He hopes his grandmother can arrange secret meetings without stirring an uproar.

faq.q: Where can Gramma Stonefield be found?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield stays inside the main Stonefield farmhouse, south of Goldshire and east of the riverbank where Tommy Joe hides.

faq.q: What is the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures?
faq.answer: The neighboring farming families carry a long personal and territorial grudge. They accuse each other of theft and compete over crops, while distrust keeps both households near violence. Their children must keep any contact secret.

faq.q: Does Gramma Stonefield oppose Tommy Joe's relationship?
faq.answer: No. Gramma knows the feud makes a lasting future difficult, but she cares for the young lovers and will devise ways for them to meet.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Gramma?
faq.answer: Gramma begins planning to bring Tommy Joe and Maybell together in secret. She sends you to gather what she needs for an invisibility liquor to get past their watchful families.
Maybell Maclure is the daughter of the rival family, living across the road from the Stonefields. She is secretly courting Tommy Joe Stonefield.

angles.text: As a human in Elwynn, you see how deeply local grudges run in Stormwind's heartlands, even amid troubles across the realm.
While Stormwind faces Defias unrest and beast attacks, you may find yourself mediating quarrels between neighboring farmers.
